LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS 8.1.1 NEWS TELLING SIGNING NEWS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.1: Observing and Articulating signs 8.1.1 News telling signing news
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating signs 8.1.1 News telling signing news, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: what a cock does in the morning, 1. How do we tell it is morning? 2. What do we do before coming to school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating signs 8.1.1 News telling signing news together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: observation and signing skills as learner articulates signs of words in sentences

correctly while telling news.

● Self-efficacy as learners tell news about daily routine.

119

● Critical thinking and problem solving: active listening and communication skills aslearner recalls their order or

routine of daily activities.

Values:
● Integrity: discipline as learner learns to keep time and do the right thing at the right time.

● Love: selflessness as learner learns together with others, practice to take turns and patience while telling news.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Social cohesion as learner learns to do the right thing at the right time while interacting with others thus maintain order.

● Link to other Activity Areas:

Mathematics Activities as the learner arrange pictures with various daily routine activities in a logical order.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Adapted course books, Signed audio visual clips, books, Flash cards, charts, pictures, online resources, relevant digital
